# Game asset sources

| Pack | Local files | Source | License | Attribution |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Kenney Tiny Farm | `kenney-tiny-farm/tilemap.png` | [kenney.nl/assets/tiny-farm](https://kenney.nl/assets/tiny-farm) | CC0 1.0 | Not required; credit to Kenney is appreciated |
| Kenney Tiny Town | `kenney-tiny-town/tilemap.png` | [kenney.nl/assets/tiny-town](https://kenney.nl/assets/tiny-town) | CC0 1.0 | Not required; credit to Kenney is appreciated |

Both packs use 16 × 16 pixel-art tiles with a 1-pixel atlas gutter. Their matching
top-down style is loaded locally by Phaser from `public/assets`; gameplay does not
depend on remote image URLs. The original packs and their licenses are published
by [Kenney](https://kenney.nl/).
